authorityBoundaries.notion: Organizational control plane: goals, initiatives, projects, tasks, ownership, decision authority, decisions, risks, releases narrative, knowledge, AI-system governance metadata, learning, next actions.
authorityBoundaries.github: Source code, branches, commits, issues, pull requests, diffs, reviews, CI and test evidence, implementation history, code-level rollback state.
authorityBoundaries.railway: Live Dime runtime and deployment truth. Merging dime-ai main has production consequences.
authorityBoundaries.credentialBrokers: 1Password + approved device-only brokers own secrets. Secrets never enter Notion, GitHub docs, logs, PR bodies, evidence, or AI context.
